scheme_name: Skill Development for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of the Union Territory of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Applicant must be a building or construction worker
Applicant must have engaged in building or construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the UT
Applicant must be enrolled under Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
Applicant must attend the training programs of Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana
benefits_summary: Financial assistance including a ₹5,000 incentive, minimum wages for skilled workers, and a travel allowance.
